# tests/test_mdutils.py
import unittest
from mdutils.tools.Header import Header

class TestHeader(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_atx_level_1(self):
        title = "Hello World"
        expected_output = "\n# Hello World\n"
        self.assertEqual(Header.atx_level_1(title), expected_output)

    def test_atx_level_2(self):
        title = "Hello World"
        expected_output = "\n## Hello World\n"
        self.assertEqual(Header.atx_level_2(title), expected_output)

    def test_atx_level_3(self):
        title = "Hello World"
        expected_output = "\n### Hello World\n"
        self.assertEqual(Header.atx_level_3(title), expected_output)

    def test_atx_level_4(self):
        title = "Hello World"
        expected_output = "\n#### Hello World\n"
        self.assertEqual(Header.atx_level_4(title), expected_output)

    def test_atx_level_5(self):
        title = "Hello World"
        expected_output = "\n##### Hello World\n"
        self.assertEqual(Header.atx_level_5(title), expected_output)

    def test_atx_level_6(self):
        title = "Hello World"
        expected_output = "\n###### Hello World\n"
        self.assertEqual(Header.atx_level_6(title), expected_output)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
